video_title: Jordan Goodwin Training Camp Media Availability | 10-3-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on his versatile role in the Suns' rotation
quotes.excerpt: I touch every position besides the five. Everything else, I have been playing pretty much everything.
quotes.quote: I touch every position besides the five. Everything else, I have been playing pretty much everything, every position, the last year or so.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin says he is taking on a versatile role for the Suns this season, noting he has been playing every position on the floor except for the five.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on his role facilitating the second unit
quotes.excerpt: I am just setting up, just getting other guys going, especially with that second unit.
quotes.quote: I am just setting up, just getting other guys going, especially with that second unit, get Collin going when he is off the ball. I am just setting guys up when I am the one.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin on his role with the second unit, saying he is focused on facilitating and getting guys like Collin involved when he is off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on the team's physical training camp intensity
quotes.excerpt: Training camp has been really good. I got a good group of guys, all locked in.
quotes.quote: Training camp has been really good. I got a good group of guys, all locked in off the court, which makes it easy on the court. Real physical, been real physical out here, but most part it has been fun. Everybody has been having fun.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin describes the Suns training camp as real physical and says the group is locked in off the court, which is making things easier on the court.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on the team's focus on injury prevention
quotes.excerpt: That was a big emphasis this summer with the training staff and everybody, just being more locked in.
quotes.quote: That was a big emphasis this summer with the training staff and everybody, just being more locked in with our guys, treating our injuries, trying to prevent them. We had a good summer, everybody was in here this summer working on their body, so definitely injuries are going to happen, but I think we did enough work in the summer to try to prevent some of them.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin says injury prevention was a major emphasis for the Suns this summer, with the team spending significant time working with the training staff to keep everyone healthy.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on Miles Bridges' impact on rebounding
quotes.excerpt: I think adding Miles is going to help us out too down there a little bit more.
quotes.quote: I think adding Miles is going to help us out too down there a little bit more with rebounding. And we are putting more emphasis on all the guards going in, crashing, getting more boards. So, trying to get some more rebounds from Jaylen, Dylan, those type of guys, they will mix in like four or five to help us out.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin expects Miles Bridges to provide a boost to the Suns rebounding efforts, noting that the team is putting a greater emphasis on guards crashing the glass this year.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on the team's internal competition and accountability
quotes.excerpt: You just don't want to be on the bottom of it. We are showing it in front of everybody.
quotes.quote: You just don't want to be on the bottom of it. We are showing it in front of everybody, so everybody sees it. If your name is at the bottom, they are going to say something about it too. Like I said, it is a good group of guys, so most of the time we are joking, but it is not joking, so it is good to see it.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin says the Suns are using internal competition to drive accountability, noting that players are held to a standard if their performance metrics end up at the bottom.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on building continuity within the team system
quotes.excerpt: We already know. We know the system, we know what we got to do.
quotes.quote: We already know. We know the system, we know what we got to do. Right now it is just building with each other, make the small improvements, and just trusting everybody's development that they did this summer.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin says the Suns are focused on building chemistry and trusting the development work everyone put in over the summer.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on his personal defensive impact and versatility
quotes.excerpt: Me just being more impactful on the ball defensively, help us out a little bit more.
quotes.quote: Me just being more impactful on the ball defensively, help us out a little bit more. Just getting more rebounds, kicking ahead, less dribbles, just get us out there more space.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin says he is looking to be more impactful on the ball defensively and wants to focus on pushing the pace with fewer dribbles to create more space.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on his personal development and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: The work I put in the weight room this summer with the training staff is going to take it.
quotes.quote: The work I put in the weight room this summer with the training staff is going to take it up to another level. Being more stronger, more athletic, move a little bit faster, help me get into positions. I think that is what helped me out a lot.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin credits his summer work in the weight room for helping him feel stronger, more athletic, and faster heading into the new season.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on how Miles Bridges helps the team's defense
quotes.excerpt: Having Miles out there in Dylan's place take a little bit more pressure off we will guard.
quotes.quote: Having Miles out there in Dylan's place take a little bit more pressure off we will guard some of those taller fours and threes last year. So, probably have me focus more on the ones and twos a little bit more this year, which I am better at guarding in the threes and fours. So having Miles, definitely going to help us out, especially on both sides.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin believes Miles Bridges will allow him to focus more on guarding ones and twos this season, which he feels is a better fit for his defensive skill set.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on the development of teammate Kamaka Hepa
quotes.excerpt: First of all, his body, man. His body is insane.
quotes.quote: First of all, his body, man. His body is insane. It is my hell of a summer, man, he had probably the best summer in here, far as everybody. But he is learning, he is getting better every day, and just like his his mindset coming into it, just being coachable, listening to everybody. He always takes it in, he always applies it too. And you can be talking a lot, and that is the main thing, young guy talking that much.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin is impressed by Kamaka Hepa, calling his physical transformation insane and praising his coachability and mindset during training camp.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Goodwin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Goodwin on building chemistry with teammates in practice
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes like last scrimmage, he was came and grabbed me, situation where I am guarding Jaylen.
quotes.quote: Sometimes like last scrimmage, he was came and grabbed me, situation where I am guarding Jaylen, Jaylen gets in the paint a little bit too lower, and I didn't want to veer, and he asked me why not. Like right there, I just told him I felt like I could have did something different. So just that, like his mind already in game, game situations. So when we get in the game, it is like he don't got to call it, we just talked about it.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Goodwin highlights the importance of real-time communication during scrimmages, noting how players are already discussing defensive rotations to prepare for game situations.
